skill_name: Compare and contrast the philosophies of Friedrich Nietzche and Jean-Paul Sartre.
workflow: Friedrich Nietzche and Jean-Paul Sartre both argued for the freedom of the individual, though Nietzsche believed in a more deterministic version, believing that it was an innate power we have from birth. Sartre however, believed in an eschatological perspective where meaning can exist in a changing world and our freedom is tied to our action and responsibility.
